A treasure hunt for iPhone

Every place hides a treasure.

Step outside, follow the clues, and meet characters in augmented reality. Your next adventure could be around the corner.

Download on the App StoreHow to playSee the app

Three steps to the treasure

  1. 01

    Pick a hunt

    Find a route on the map, join a private hunt with a code, or create your own route.

  2. 02

    Follow the clues

    Visit the stops and solve a puzzle at each one.

  3. 03

    Find the treasure

    Meet characters in augmented reality and reach the final reveal.

A look inside the hunt

Create a new route

Pick the stops, add clues and characters, then share an invite code with friends or family.

Play safely.

Stay aware of traffic, obstacles and your surroundings. Never use the app while driving, and children should play with adult supervision.
